summary: Iteration 6 — verified password-reset flow (forgot/reset), rebuilt login pages, and the /request-a-car demand flow. BACKEND: 54/54 pytest pass in 10.9s (47 previous + 7 new in test_password_reset.py covering forgot-ok, no-enumeration, e2e reset+login, invalid-token 400, short-password 400, expired-token 400, city-interest→city_requests+lead(source=city_request)). FRONTEND E2E on live URL: /forgot-password (forgot-email/forgot-submit) → forgot-success shown. Read reset token directly from db.password_reset_tokens; /reset-password?token=… mismatch shows error ("passwords do not match"); correct match redirects to /login; logging in on rebuilt /login (login-email/login-password/login-submit) with NEW password lands on /portal. /login exposes login-forgot; /operator-login renders with oplogin-forgot. /search?city=London → sr-request-car-btn navigates to /request-a-car?city=London; full form (city-vehicle/budget/note/name/phone/email/submit) → city-interest-success. Regression: /register renders 3-step driver flow; /admin login OK and Trend chart 'Growth over the last 14 days' visible with Page views / Driver signups / Leads legend + KPI tiles (Total leads captured, Driver accounts, Operators interested, Cities requested).

minor.issue: Register still does not enforce a min-length on password (carried from iter5). /auth/reset-password does enforce >=6, /auth/register does not. LOW.

action_items: (LOW / carried) Add Pydantic min_length=6 to RegisterBody.password for parity with ResetPassword and UI.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py forgot_password correctly returns {ok:true} for both known/unknown emails — no user enumeration. Token stored with `used:false`, 1h TTL, and a TTL index on expires_at (server.py:522).
backend/server.py reset_password validates password>=6, checks used flag, checks expiry (tz-aware) — reuse of same token returns 400 as expected. Verified end-to-end.
backend/emailer.py fire()/send_reset are non-blocking and no-op when EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY absent (by design; no bug).
frontend/pages/ResetPassword.jsx validates password==confirm on submit and shows inline error; redirects to /login on success (verified).
frontend/pages/SearchResults.jsx sr-request-car-btn navigates to /request-a-car?city=<city>; RequestCar.jsx wires CityInterestForm mode='request' with the budget field.
Consider: /auth/register missing min-length validation (users can register with password shorter than 6 that they then can't reset to via /auth/reset-password) — mild inconsistency.

New key testids: forgot-email, forgot-submit, forgot-success; reset-password, reset-confirm, reset-submit; sr-request-car-btn, city-vehicle/city-budget/city-note/city-name/city-phone/city-email/city-submit, city-interest-success; login-email/login-password/login-submit/login-forgot; oplogin-email/oplogin-password/oplogin-submit/oplogin-forgot.
